title: Typed locomotion frame adaptation and deterministic replay gate
problem: E74-E77 allowed coordinate-frame hypotheses to reach full PIE/Chaos runs before the world, actor, mesh-facing, animation-data, canonical Proto, policy-heading-local, and future-mimic frames were represented explicitly. The resulting product evidence cannot isolate which conversion is wrong.
single_change: Add a pure typed locomotion frame-adaptation layer plus a deterministic one-step replay record and factorial validator. Do not wire a new candidate into live Pose Search, PHC inference, Physics Control, or Chaos during E79.
locked_invariants: No full scripted-locomotion product bundle is executed
No active Pose Search, policy observation, mimic-target, Physics Control, Chaos, gain, action, or protocol behavior changes
scripted-locomotion.v1.json and scripted-locomotion.v2.json remain byte-for-byte unchanged
Every vector/quaternion crossing the new boundaries carries its frame in the type or field name
Existing PhysAnimBridge observation and mimic builders remain the training-contract authority
A candidate may be promoted only if all deterministic frame invariants pass
tdd_red: The new typed adapter API is referenced by tests before implementation
The deterministic replay record is rejected when any required stream is absent or shape-invalid
At least one deliberately wrong candidate fails authored-forward or yaw-preservation checks
At least one deliberately wrong candidate fails future-root-progression or current/future-convention checks
Zero velocity, translation magnitude, and orientation round-trip invariants are independently asserted
Self-observation and mimic-target vector lengths must equal the existing training-contract constants
acceptance: A deterministic replay record contains actor and mesh transforms, trajectory, selected animation/time, current and future animation roots, physical bodies, canonical bodies, self observation, mimic target, and policy action signature
The factorial validator reports each candidate and the exact failed invariants
Only candidates passing every invariant are returned as survivors
Existing ProtoManny adapter and locomotion protocol tests remain green
No Chaos product run is performed
